summary: Round 1; no prior council blocking IDs were supplied, hence previous_status is empty. Applied the inherited interpreter rubric to the stated arithmetic-producer scope, not to unrelated executor features. Method 1: independently derived binary16 1+2^-11 as an even tie to 0x3c00 with inexact; minimum subnormal times 1/2 as 0 with underflow|inexact for nearest and 1 for upward; max finite plus itself toward zero as 0x7bff with overflow|inexact; sqrt(-1) as canonical 0x7e00 with invalid; and finite tanh(78), downward, as 0x3bff with inexact. All six cases passed on both fresh publication bridges. Derived modular 3*31 mod 11=5, nine executed rows; observed (5,0,9) at B=9 and (0,1,8) at B=8. Constructed the Cuccaro width-one envelope independently and reproduced its recorded hash. Method 2: hand-traced a recursive lift.call with old fp=4, sp=12, depth=1, two callee locations (5,9), R_f=5 and one captured argument 5: forward stores the old locations at stack[15:17], binds the argument and sets (fp,sp,depth)=(12,17,2); C5 inverse restores counters before C4/C3/C2/C1 undo, leaving all slots and headers clean. Traced the corresponding ret of 8: restore callee fp before undoing delivery, then restore callee locations before clearing the result capture and successor. Included dispatch and pc exchanges in both traces. Also traced a §7.4 call/store/ret, pure copy, uncall sequence: the store is restored once and the pure copied result survives until its own reversal. These are spec derivations, not claims that this library owns a CC/R executor. Method 3: no SPEC-QUESTIONS file; reviewed the documented PPC priority/parity readings, libm limits and six circuit-gap entries, noting stale pin/admission prose. Method 4: classified all requested grep hits in production/test source; no silent stub was identified. Method 5: checked the seven-format §13 entry-point families, wide/powi/pair routes and generated op dispatch against the manifest; all 1,141 signatures per major and three parametric families are accounted for. ISA gate/row, frame and fault inventories were checked for the producer's emitted subset; execution of un-emitted general ISA features belongs to the consumer. Validation: 11,970 exact directed IEEE checks and 12 PPC parity checks per major, source/hash audits, both checksum sets, and 130 reproduced circuit files passed. The focused circuit replay failed reproducibly; base/current comparison isolates the regression. No full suite, scripts/build, scripts/gate, commit, or tracked-file modification was performed.
